detail.body:
## Motivation

@humansand

Add startup autotuning for the existing FlashInfer MegaMoE NVFP4 W4A4 and MXFP8
backends. The generic FlashInfer autotune context does not trigger MegaMoE's
native tuner. Tune representative decode/prefill capacities before CUDA graph
capture, then select a fixed workspace using synchronized DP token counts.

This is the standalone autotune prerequisite for
[#39210](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/39210). W4A16 integration stays
in that separate PR. Uses the FlashInfer 0.7.1 dependency already on `main`.

## Modifications

- **Startup:** participate in the existing target-model autotune lifecycle by
  default. Prepare powers-of-two decode capacities plus the exact decode ceiling
  and one prefill ceiling. Decode bounds cover captured graphs, eager request
  limits, and maximum speculative width. Preparing the native prefill profile
  does not enable `SGLANG_FLASHINFER_AUTOTUNE_EXTEND`.
- **Representative inputs:** repeat or slice the startup batch to each capacity;
  synthesize inputs for idle ranks. Native `knobs="auto"` otherwise measures its
  first live input while caching under workspace capacity. Tune temporary owners,
  then destroy them and warm fixed public workspace handles before capture.
- **Runtime selection:** use the largest synchronized DP count to choose the
  smallest covering profile on every EP rank. Retain local expert inputs and
  existing DP bookkeeping; reject capacity overflow. No tuning or cache-file
  access occurs in ordinary forwards.
- **Workspace ownership:** use FlashInfer's reference-counted pool instead of
  assigning private workspaces across layers. Stage existing per-layer NVFP4
  scales on every forward; use the public output-view capability and released
  `enable_in_kernel_fc2_reduce` keyword. The FC2 flag permits atomic candidates;
  the selected tactic can still use external reduction.
- **Persistence:** store native tactic payloads in the existing FlashInfer
  namespaced cache. Stage each geometry/capacity once per startup context and
  retain process-local winners for already-pooled workspaces. Target MegaMoE
  cache filenames include physical GPU UUIDs; engines sharing physical GPUs
  need separate `SGLANG_CACHE_DIR` roots. Cache-disabled runs use unique filenames.
- **Boundaries:** native tuning requires EP to span WORLD because FlashInfer
  0.7.1's tuner uses WORLD collectives. Draft profiles are not added. Existing
  disable, deterministic-mode, and skip-op controls preserve normal forwarding;
  DeepGEMM keeps its existing forward path. No W4A16/SiTU, quantization/loader,
  model-specific, NVSHMEM, Dockerfile, or dependency-pin changes.

Use `--flashinfer-autotune-skip-ops flashinfer_megamoe` to skip just this tuner,
or `--disable-flashinfer-autotune` to disable startup FlashInfer tuning.

## Accuracy Tests

**Environment and source**

- **Tested source:** `0b0ff32ee67e9218fe4d5867a1732436adcef6b8`, based on upstream
  `208df292e541246c4b88a11131474c804119047b`. The pinned checkout, clean tracked
  files, and source import paths were verified before each unit/native run.
- **Image:** `lmsysorg/sglang:nightly-dev-cu13-20261012-e6072935`; index digest
  `sha256:b5c488694d74c13587af6057b90220498c4869571c8e1e3c43dd6f43ae721306`,
  amd64 manifest digest
  `sha256:e20a28a4badee7d3de71881e7c2c160c7079465bf1ac21edec31a99c2602507d`.
- **Hardware:** four NVIDIA B300 SXM6 AC GPUs per native/serving case, with
  275040 MiB reported per GPU; driver `590.48.01`. Native runs used physical
  GPUs 0–3 while independent correctness validation used GPUs 4–7. Timing from
  these runs is not performance evidence.
- **Runtime:** Python `3.12.15`, PyTorch `2.14.1+cu130` / CUDA `13.0`,
  `flashinfer-python==0.7.1`, `flashinfer-cubin==0.7.1`,
  `flashinfer-jit-cache==0.7.1+cu130`, CUTLASS DSL and its CUDA 13 libs `4.8.0`,
  `nvidia-nvshmem-cu13==3.4.5`, `nvshmem4py-cu13==0.4.0`.
- **FlashInfer installation:** installed the official released binary wheels,
  including the CUDA 13 architecture providers. Build metadata identifies
  release commit `0b46115d238d29ea2e92c6b9b2cb077d40fbc352`. No FlashInfer source
  build or editable installation. All non-FlashInfer Python distributions and the image's
  `sgl_kernel` shared-library hashes were unchanged. CuTe DSL kernels specialize
  normally at runtime.
- **Source-checkout setup:** the image sets `SGLANG_RUST_BUILD_MODE=never`, but
  its bundled Rust TreeCore binary targets newer source than this PR. Build the
  pinned SGLang Rust extension with Rust/Cargo `1.92.0` into the
  source-fingerprinted task cache before
  launching the server, then keep normal server mode `never`. This does not
  rebuild FlashInfer or alter installed packages.
- **NVSHMEM setup:** the single-node runs explicitly use
  `NVSHMEM_REMOTE_TRANSPORT=none`, `NVSHMEM_IB_ENABLE_IBGDA=0`, and
  `NVSHMEM_DISABLE_LOCAL_ONLY_PROXY=1`. The native harness bypasses `ServerArgs`;
  this PR does not change NVSHMEM defaults. The local-only proxy issue is
  addressed by [NVIDIA/nvshmem@af9e239](https://github.com/NVIDIA/nvshmem/commit/af9e2391a849d1a36b4be09c3f6f20d622dada1b),
  with context in [NVIDIA/nvshmem#110](https://github.com/NVIDIA/nvshmem/pull/110).

Before serving from the pinned checkout, prepare its Rust TreeCore cache:

```bash
CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES="" CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=4 SGLANG_RUST_BUILD_MODE=auto \
python -B -c 'from sglang.srt.mem_cache.rust_tree_core.extension import bindings; print(bindings.__file__)'
CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES="" SGLANG_RUST_BUILD_MODE=never \
python -B -c 'from sglang.srt.mem_cache.rust_tree_core.extension import bindings; print(bindings.__file__)'
```

The loader uses locked Cargo dependencies and a source/toolchain/PyTorch
fingerprint; server launches reuse this artifact with mode `never`. The initial
serving attempt reached the end of MegaMoE tuning but failed while loading this
unrelated missing extension. Its complete log is retained separately from the
repaired-environment retry.

Source imports use `PYTHONPATH`; remaining Python/CUDA packages come from the image.
Separate source, FlashInfer, CuTe DSL, PyTorch extension, and tuning cache roots
were used for this PR. Only the verified model download cache was shared.

</details>

**Registered unit tests**

The existing registered suites run in the full image without the local CPU
bootstrap harness. Their own test fixtures/mocks remain in place. This covers
15 adapter/profile cases, runner/cache startup, the legacy-accessor source rule,
and DP scheduler metadata; native CUDA execution is covered separately below.

```bash
cd "$TASK_ROOT/sglang"
CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 python -B -m pytest -q -ra \
  test/registered/unit/layers/moe/test_flashinfer_megamoe.py \
  test/registered/unit/model_executor/runner/test_flashinfer_autotune_sync.py \
  test/registered/unit/test_runtime_context.py::TestTheAccessorsHaveNoCallersOutsideTheirPackage \
  test/registered/unit/managers/scheduler_components/test_dp_attn.py::TestDPAttnSchedulerMetadata \
  --junitxml="$TASK_ROOT/results/units.xml"
```

Raw footer:

```text
33 passed, 21 warnings, 7 subtests passed in 181.16s (0:03:01)
```

JUnit records 40 entries including the seven subtests, with zero failures,
errors, or skips. Full warning output and JUnit are retained with the raw logs.

**Native W4A4 and MXFP8 autotune/capture validation**

- **Fixture:** EP4/WORLD, synthetic SwiGLU, hidden/intermediate size 256, eight
  experts, top-k 4, two layer owners and separate startup contexts. Both paths
  use their actual SGLang weight preprocessing and the released native kernels.
- **Profiles:** bootstrap 4, decode ceiling 16, prefill ceiling 8; capacities
  `[1, 2, 4, 8, 16]`. Synchronized DP counts are supplied as
  `[0, 1, 1, 2]`, `[0, 1, 2, 7]`, `[8, 8, 8, 8]`, and `[0, 4, 9, 16]`.
  These include unequal and idle ranks; full scheduler behavior is outside
  this fixture.
- **Oracle:** compare against independent fixed-default native MegaMoE sessions
  (`knobs={}`, capacity 16), with immediate clones of pooled output views for
  both owners. This is the same released FlashInfer kernel family, not a BF16
  or PyTorch mathematical oracle. Both results must be finite and bitwise
  equal as BF16; no tolerance is applied.
- **Capture:** two unchanged CUDA graph replays and one replay after mutating
  activations, plus FC1 scales for W4A4, for each count fixture. Assert shared
  workspace identity and reference counts `2 → 1 → 0` during owner teardown.
- **Persistence:** the native AUTO wrapper only counts calls. All candidates,
  kernels, tuning, and dispatch remain unchanged. Cold startup invokes AUTO
  five times per rank; warm restart invokes it zero times. Both owners' eight
  cache files per precision contain identical namespaced records for all five
  capacities.

The retained `smoke_autotune_gpu.py` is a standalone validation helper, outside
this PR's source diff. The full native commands are:

```bash
export CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0,1,2,3
export NVSHMEM_REMOTE_TRANSPORT=none
export NVSHMEM_IB_ENABLE_IBGDA=0
export NVSHMEM_DISABLE_LOCAL_ONLY_PROXY=1
export SGLANG_FLASHINFER_CUTEDSL_NVFP4_W4A16=0
export SGLANG_FLASHINFER_MEGAMOE_IN_KERNEL_FC2_REDUCE=0
export SGLANG_FLASHINFER_MEGAMOE_COMBINE_DTYPE=bf16
export SGLANG_FLASHINFER_MEGAMOE_MAX_TOKENS_PER_RANK=4
export FLASHINFER_MOE_EP_KNOB_CACHE=0

for precision in w4a4 mxfp8; do
  for reuse in 0 1; do
    timeout --kill-after=30s 90m \
      torchrun --nnodes=1 --nproc-per-node=4 --master-addr=127.0.0.1 \
      --master-port=29546 "$TASK_ROOT/c2-tests/smoke_autotune_gpu.py" \
      --cache "$TASK_ROOT/results/native-$precision-cache" --reuse-cache "$reuse" \
      --decode-num-tokens 16 --precision "$precision"
  done
done
```

All 384 comparisons were finite and bitwise exact, with maximum absolute error

per-comparison records, selected native knobs, cache payloads, command receipts,

in `c2-20261012/remote-results/` and `NATIVE_VALIDATION.json`.

**W4A4 serving accuracy**

Model: `nvidia/Qwen3-30B-A3B-NVFP4`, pinned Hugging Face revision
`2538ded2a4edb247b4d2b4a8ba24e44bd4c017c3`. TP4 / attention DP4 / EP4;
max running requests 64; decode CUDA graphs up to 64; prefill CUDA graphs
disabled; chunked prefill 4096; static memory fraction 0.7; BF16 combine;
per-token activation quantization and in-kernel FC2 reduction disabled.
Startup FlashInfer tuning remains enabled by default. No speculative decoding.

Full server command (the test helper resolves this public model to the pinned
local snapshot):

```bash
export MODEL_PATH="$(hf download nvidia/Qwen3-30B-A3B-NVFP4 \
  --revision 2538ded2a4edb247b4d2b4a8ba24e44bd4c017c3)"
unset SGLANG_FLASHINFER_MEGAMOE_MAX_TOKENS_PER_RANK FLASHINFER_MOE_EP_KNOB_CACHE
CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0,1,2,3 \
SGLANG_FLASHINFER_CUTEDSL_NVFP4_W4A16=0 \
SGLANG_FLASHINFER_NVFP4_PER_TOKEN_ACTIVATION=0 \
SGLANG_FLASHINFER_MEGAMOE_IN_KERNEL_FC2_REDUCE=0 \
SGLANG_FLASHINFER_MEGAMOE_COMBINE_DTYPE=bf16 \
SGLANG_ENABLE_JIT_DEEPGEMM=False \
NVSHMEM_REMOTE_TRANSPORT=none \
NVSHMEM_IB_ENABLE_IBGDA=0 \
NVSHMEM_DISABLE_LOCAL_ONLY_PROXY=1 \
sglang serve \
  --model-path "$MODEL_PATH" \
  --dtype bfloat16 \
  --tp-size 4 --attn-dp-size 4 --ep-size 4 \
  --moe-runner-backend flashinfer_megamoe \
  --moe-a2a-backend flashinfer_megamoe \
  --cuda-graph-backend-prefill disabled \
  --cuda-graph-max-bs-decode 64 \
  --max-running-requests 64 \
  --chunked-prefill-size 4096 \
  --mem-fraction-static 0.7 \
  --device cuda --host 127.0.0.1 --port 31100
```

After server readiness, run 200 GSM8K examples with 128 client threads,
completion API, a 512-token output cap, and the script defaults
(temperature 0, top-p 1). The test requires score strictly greater than 0.90.

```bash
python -m sglang.test.run_eval \
  --base-url http://127.0.0.1:31100 \
  --model "$MODEL_PATH" \
  --eval-name gsm8k --num-examples 200 --num-threads 128 \
  --api completion --max-tokens 512
```

**Result:** passed, **92.5% (185/200)**, with 200 logged HTTP 200 completion
responses and no traceback. Both the test and its supervisor exited 0. Raw
result (latency/throughput are incidental evaluator fields, not benchmark evidence):

```json
{
  "score:std": 0.26339134382131846,
  "score": 0.925,
  "latency": 24.68711337633431,
  "output_throughput": 1023.2869114708564
}
```

The effective per-rank settings were 16 running requests, 1024-token chunked
prefill, and captured decode batches `[1, 2, 4, 8, 12, 16]`; the requested limits
above produced these DP-adjusted runtime limits. The checkpoint selected FP8
E4M3 KV cache; context
length was 40960. Startup reused native profiles `[1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 1024]` from
the first attempt's completed tuning: six cache-hit entries and no new native
tuning entries in the successful retry. No source or package edits were needed.


**Supplemental local checks and remaining scope**

- CPU checks on macOS 27.0.1 arm64 / Python 3.12.12 / PyTorch 2.14.0: adapter
  harness `15 passed`; cache harness `Ran 16 tests ... OK (skipped=1)` including
  four local cache-isolation cases; AST-scoped unchanged legacy-accessor check
  `Ran 1 test ... OK`. The CPU harnesses stub CUDA/native interfaces; Gloo,
  process spawning, runtime-context overrides, and cache-file operations are
  real. Their CUDA-only skip is separate from the zero-skip image result above.
- All eight changed Python files parse; `git diff --check` and applicable
  pre-commit checks pass. Mintlify site checks were unavailable locally because
  `mint` is not installed; the MDX changes update existing table text.
- MXFP8 full-model serving, larger native shapes, other activations, other
  combine/reduction modes, and BF16-oracle numerics are not validated by these
  native fixtures. W4A16 remains in its separate PR.

```bash
git diff --check 208df292e541246c4b88a11131474c804119047b...HEAD
git diff --name-only 208df292e541246c4b88a11131474c804119047b...HEAD | xargs pre-commit run --files
```

## Speed Tests and Profiling

No controlled serving benchmark or speed comparison was run. No speedup is claimed.

detail.title: [FlashInfer] Add startup autotuning for MegaMoE

files.patch: @@ -164,7 +164,7 @@ SGLang supports various environment variables that can be used to configure its `SGLANG_FLASHINFER_AUTOTUNE_CACHE` - Reuse persisted FlashInfer autotune results from `SGLANG_CACHE_DIR` across runs. Set to `0` to force re-autotuning on every startup; the fresh result is written to a `runs/..json` sibling file (the canonical cache is left untouched). + Reuse persisted FlashInfer autotune results from `SGLANG_CACHE_DIR` across runs, including MegaMoE capacity profiles. Set to `0` to disable disk-cache reuse; the fresh result is written to a `runs/...json` sibling file (the canonical cache is left untouched). Target MegaMoE rank files include the physical GPU UUID. Use separate `SGLANG_CACHE_DIR` roots for engines sharing physical GPUs; a running process retains tactics for already-pooled workspaces. `true` @@ -363,7 +363,7 @@ SGLang supports various environment variables that can be used to configure its SGLANG_FLASHINFER_MEGAMOE_IN_KERNEL_FC2_REDUCE - Use the CuTe DSL MegaMOE in-kernel FC2 reduction. This can reduce workspace size and improve large-batch performance, but BF16 atomic accumulation is nondeterministic. It is incompatible with quantized combine dtypes. + Permit CuTe DSL MegaMOE in-kernel FC2 reduction for NVFP4 and MXFP8. FlashInfer's tuning profile may still select external reduction. BF16 atomic accumulation is nondeterministic; leave disabled for reproducibility. Requires BF16 combine. "false"

@@ -1096,9 +1096,10 @@ class Envs:
     # (derived from cuda_graph_max_bs / chunked_prefill_size when unset).
     SGLANG_FLASHINFER_MEGAMOE_MAX_TOKENS_PER_RANK = EnvInt(0)
     # Opt-in in-kernel FC2 top-k reduce (cross-rank REDG atomic-add) for the
-    # cutedsl mega kernels (NVFP4 / MXFP8). Deletes the multi-GB combine staging
